inclusion_criteria.title: Domain Relevance
inclusion_criteria.desc: The study must propose, evaluate, or survey data deduplication techniques, frameworks, algorithms, or architectures.

inclusion_criteria.title: Specific Context
inclusion_criteria.desc: The study must focus on chunk-level deduplication, entity resolution, or sequence deduplication in empirical settings.

inclusion_criteria.title: Contribution Type
inclusion_criteria.desc: The study must present a primary contribution, such as a new algorithm, an empirical evaluation, a taxonomic framework, or a comprehensive review.

inclusion_criteria.title: Language
inclusion_criteria.desc: The study must be written entirely in English.

inclusion_criteria.title: Publication Type
inclusion_criteria.desc: The study must be peer-reviewed and published in a conference proceeding, journal, or book chapter.

exclusion_criteria.title: Out of Scope
exclusion_criteria.desc: The study focuses on deduplication in an unrelated domain (e.g., excluding record linkage if focus is hardware storage deduplication).

exclusion_criteria.title: Secondary Focus
exclusion_criteria.desc: The study mentions deduplication only as a passing example or minor pre-processing step without detailing the underlying mechanism.

exclusion_criteria.title: Data Limits
exclusion_criteria.desc: The study lacks sufficient technical details, evaluation metrics, or empirical data to assess its validity.

exclusion_criteria.title: Grey Literature
exclusion_criteria.desc: The study is an extended abstract, preprint (e.g., arXiv papers without peer review), editorial, white paper, or presentation slide deck.
